description: A Dart class `ApiClient` implementing a flexible client for backend API interactions, including authentication, token refresh, CRUD operations for books and categories, user management, and analytics fetching.

classes.name: ApiClient
classes.description: Client for backend API with JWT token handling, including login, token refresh, CRUD operations, and auxiliary functionalities.

methods.name: apiBase
methods.description: Getter for the base URL of the API, reads from environment variables with fallback to localhost.

methods.name: set onForceLogout
methods.description: Setter to assign callback invoked when user must be forcibly logged out, e.g., on expired refresh token.

methods.name: _request
methods.description: Core method performing HTTP requests with support for retries on 401 errors via token refresh.

methods.name: _tryRefresh
methods.description: Attempts to refresh authentication tokens when they expire, updating session accordingly.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Authenticates user with email and password, updates tokens and user info upon success.

methods.name: loginGoogle
methods.description: Authenticates user with Google ID token, updates session.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Clears session tokens and user info, logging out the user.

methods.name: isLoggedIn
methods.description: Checks whether the user is currently authenticated.

methods.name: listBooks
methods.description: Fetches list of books with optional search, pagination, including full admin view.

methods.name: updateBook
methods.description: Updates an existing book by ID.

methods.name: listCategories
methods.description: Fetches list of categories with optional search and pagination.

methods.name: getPresignedUploadUrl
methods.description: Requests a presigned URL for file uploads (cover or file).
